about: Solomon, speaking with Makeda, sees a sweating laborer, calls him over, and asks what separates a king from such a man; both are mortal, and God gives strength as he wills. He preaches repentance, mercy and humility over pride and the Devil. The queen praises his words and asks whom she should worship, explaining that her people bow to the sun; she has heard that Israel's God sent the Ark and the tablets by Moses, and asks whether he himself comes down to them.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፯ is 20 + 7 = 27. በእንተ 'concerning' takes a construct. ገባራዊ is ገባር 'laborer, workman' + the adjective ending -ዊ (-āwi, 'of, pertaining to'), so 'the laborer-ly (one)', used as a heading for 'the laborer'; I render it 'the Laborer'. The root ገብረ 'work, do' gives ገባር 'laborer' and also አገበረ 'make (someone) work', which recurs below.

sentences.l: And-while this he-was-speaking-with-her to-the-queen, seeing [he saw] to-one laborer while he-carries a-stone upon his-head, and-a-skin(?)-of water upon his-neck, and-his-provisions and-his-sandals(?) at his-loins, and-also-the-wood he-gathered-them in his-hands, and-worn and-torn(?) his-clothes, and-his-sweat dripping from his-face, and-the-water-of the-skin(?) also flowing to his-feet.
sentences.i: While he was saying this to the queen, he saw a laborer carrying a stone on his head and a water-skin (?) on his neck, with his food and his sandals (?) at his waist and sticks gathered in his hands. His clothes were worn and torn, sweat dripped from his face, and the water from the skin ran down onto his feet.
sentences.n: ወእንዘ 'and while' (ወ- + እንዘ, which introduces a circumstantial clause with the imperfect). ይትናገራ 'he was speaking with her' (ተናገረ 'speak, converse' + -ኣ 'her'); the speaker is Solomon, continuing from the end of the last part. ርእዮ is the 3ms gerund 'seeing, having seen' (not the bare 3ms perfect ርእየ), so 'he saw' by the sense; note that ርእየ + -ኦ 'he saw him' is spelled the same, with ለ፩ ገባር restating the object, and the English is the same either way. ለ፩ ገባር: ለ- marks the object, ፩ 'one', ገባር 'laborer' (from ገብረ 'work'). ይጸውር 'he carries' (ጾረ). እብነ 'stone' is accusative (-ä); ዲበ 'upon'. ሳእረ ማይ: I do not firmly know ሳእር. It must be a container, since the next clause says ማየ ሳእር 'the water of the ሳእር' runs onto his feet, so I read 'water-skin' with (?). ስንቁ 'his provisions' (ስንቅ + -ሁ, vowel run together). ዓሣእኒሁ 'his sandals' (?): ሣእን is a sandal as I recall it, the plural (አሣእን, before the suffix አሣእኒ-) + -ሁ 'his'; uncertain. ሐቌሁ 'his loins, waist'. ለዕፀውኒ: ለ- (object marker) + ዕፀው 'trees, wood, sticks' + -ኒ 'also'; ደመሮን 'he gathered them' (ደመረ 'gather, add together' + the 3fp suffix -ሆን 'them', f. because ዕፀው is treated as a feminine plural). ብሉያት 'worn' (feminine plural of ብሉይ, 'old, worn') and ሥጡጣት 'torn' (?) (a feminine plural; I cannot confirm the root ሠጠጠ 'tear' I took it from, and the sense rests on its pairing with ብሉያት 'worn'; both agree with the plural አልባሲሁ 'his clothes'). ሃፉ 'his sweat' (ሃፍ 'sweat' + -ሁ, as I recall; uncertain); ያንጠበጥብ 'it drips' (a quadriliteral stem). ይውኅዝ 'it flows' (ውኅዘ). ሰኰናሁ 'his feet' (ሰኰና, properly 'hoof, sole').

sentences.l: And-he-passed which [fem.] before-him.
sentences.i: He passed by in front of him.
sentences.n: ወኀለፈ 'and he passed' (ኀለፈ 'pass, go by'; the laborer). ቅድሜሁ 'before him' (ቅድሜ 'front' + -ሁ). እንተ is the feminine relative 'which'. The likeliest reading is an elliptical relative clause with a feminine antecedent understood (for example ፍኖት 'road', which is feminine): 'he passed (the way) which was before him'. A prepositional use 'along, past' is also possible, and I am not sure; the English gives only the sense on which both agree.

sentences.i: Then he turned to the queen and said to her, "Look at this man. What is my advantage over him? What is my excellence beyond his? What is my honor compared with one like him?
sentences.n: ወተመይጠ 'and he turned' (ተመይጠ, the ተ- stem of መይጠ 'turn, return'); ኀበ 'to'; ንግሥት 'queen' here stands bare, as a title. ርእዪ is the feminine imperative of ርእየ 'see' (to the queen). ምንት 'what' is followed by three nouns with the suffix -የ 'my': ፍድፍድናየ, ኅይስናየ, ክብርየ. ፍድፍድና is, I think, 'superiority, excess' (cf. ፍድፋድ 'abundance'), and ኅይስና 'goodness, excellence' (?); both are guesses from the sequence, which climbs to ክብር 'honor'. እምነ 'than, beyond' makes the comparison: እምነ ዝንቱ 'than this one', እምነዝ 'than this' (with the demonstrative ዝ), እምነ ከመዝ 'than the like of this'. The three questions are one rhetorical question; a king asks what separates him from a laborer.

sentences.l: For I-also [am] man and-dust, who tomorrow(?) I-shall-be [ʿəṣe] and-[ṣiʾät(?)]; and-now yet I-appear as one-who not-dies for-ever.
sentences.i: For I too am a man and dust, and tomorrow I shall be [ʿəṣe] and [ṣiʾät] (?); and yet now I appear as one who will never die.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'; አነሂ 'I also' (አነ + -ኒ/-ሂ, the enclitic 'also, indeed'). ሐመድ 'dust, ashes' recalls Genesis 3:19 and the creation from earth that closes the previous part. ዘጌሠመ: ዘ- + ጌሠም 'tomorrow', literally 'of tomorrow, who tomorrow'; the case-ending is unusual, so uncertain. The words ዕፄ and ወጺአት I cannot read. ዕፄ elsewhere is 'emperor', which cannot be meant here, and ጺአት is unknown to me (a word for corruption or dung would suit, but I do not know it), so both are left in brackets. እከውን 'I shall be' (ኮነ). ወይእዜ እንከ 'and now then, and yet now'. ኣስተርኢ 'I appear, am made to appear' (አስተርአየ, the causative-reflexive of ርእየ 'see'). ዘኢይመውት 'who does not die' (ዘ- + negative ኢ- + ይመውት), ለዓለም 'forever'. The sense is clear: Solomon, in his glory, is as mortal as the laborer.

sentences.l: Who from-[he-freed]-him to-God, if he-gave to-this-one like-me, and-to-me also, when he-made-me-work like-him?
sentences.i: Who could have restrained God (?), if he had given this man a lot like mine, or had made me work as he does?
sentences.n: This is a hard sentence and my reading is uncertain. መኑ 'who?'; እምአግአዞ 'from he-freed/released him' (እም- + አግአዘ, which usually means 'set free, release' + -ኦ 'him'; what እም- does before a finite verb I cannot say); ለእግዚኣብሔር 'to/for God'. I take the sense to be 'who could constrain God?', that is, nothing stopped God from making the two of them alike. The rest is plainer: እመ ወሀቦ ለዝንቱ ከማየ 'if he had given to this one like me' (ወሀበ 'give' + -ሁ 'him'; ከማየ 'like me'), ወሊተኒ ሶበ አገበረኒ ከማሁ 'and to me too, when he made me work like him' (ሊተ 'to me' + -ኒ 'also'; አገበረ, the causative of ገብረ, 'make (someone) work', + -ኒ 'me'; ከማሁ 'like him'). The English keeps both halves positive, as the Geʿez has them (no negative stands in either), and 'restrained' is my interpretation of the sense, not a translation of አግአዘ, which itself means 'set free'.

morph.gloss: from he set him free (?) (እም- + 3ms perfect 'set free' + -ኦ 'him'; the function of እም- before a finite verb and the sense of the clause are uncertain)
of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
and to me also (ወ- + ሊተ '1s to me' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
he made me work (3ms perfect, causative of ገብረ, + -ኒ 'me')

sentences.t: አኮኑ ፡ ክልኤነ ፡ ሰንቡእ ፤
sentences.tr: ʾäkonu kəlʾenä sänbuʾ
sentences.l: Are-we-not two [sänbuʾ]?
sentences.i: Are we two not [sänbuʾ] (?)
sentences.n: አኮኑ 'is it not so?' (አኮ 'not' + -ኑ, the question particle). ክልኤነ 'we two, both of us' (ክልኤ 'two' + -ነ 'us'). ሰንቡእ I do not know. The next unit glosses it with ሰብእ 'man', so it may be a variant or dialect form of 'man' (or a form from the root of 'human'); I keep the bracket.

morph.gloss: is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
we two, both of us (numeral 'two' + -ነ '1cp us')
[sänbuʾ], meaning unknown (?); perhaps a variant of ሰብእ 'man'

sentences.t: ሰብእ ፡ ብሂል ፤
sentences.tr: säbʾ bəhil
sentences.l: Man, that-is [lit. saying].
sentences.i: (that is, "man").
sentences.n: ሰብእ ብሂል 'man, that is to say' (ብሂል is the verbal noun of ይቤ 'say', literally 'a saying/meaning', used as a gloss formula 'that is, meaning'). The sentence defines the preceding word.

morph.gloss: saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)

sentences.t: ወከመ ፡ ሞተዝ ፡ ሞትየ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ሕይወተዝ ፡ ሕይወትየ ፡ ወዝንቱ ፡ ይጸንዕ ፡ በግብር ፡ እምኔየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይሁቦሙ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ለድኩማን ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ለሊሁ ፤
sentences.tr: wäkämä motäz motyä wäkämä ḥəywätäz ḥəywätyä wäznətu yəṣänʿ bägbər ʾəmneyä ʾəsmä yəhubomu ḫäylä lädkuman bäkämä fäqädä lälihu
sentences.l: And-as this death my-death and-as this life my-life; and-this one is-strong in-work than-me, for he-gives-them strength to-the-weak as he-willed himself;
sentences.i: As this man's death, so is mine; as his life, so is mine. And he is stronger than I in work, for God gives strength to the weak as he himself wills."
sentences.n: ወከመ ሞተዝ ሞትየ 'and as this death (is), my death': ሞት 'death' + the demonstrative -ዝ 'this'; the same in ሕይወተዝ ሕይወትየ 'this life, my life', and in each case the verb 'is' is understood. ወዝንቱ 'and this one'; ይጸንዕ 'he is strong' (ጸንዐ), በግብር 'in work' (ግብር 'work, deed'), እምኔየ 'than me' (እም- + -ኔየ). እስመ 'for'; ይሁቦሙ 'he gives them' (ይሁብ + -ሙ), ኀይለ 'strength' (accusative), ለድኩማን 'to the weak' (ድኩም plural; ለ- marks the recipient). በከመ ፈቀደ ለሊሁ 'as he himself desired' (ፈቀደ 'wish, will'; ለሊሁ 'himself' for emphasis). The subject of ይሁቦሙ is God.

morph.gloss: and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
he gives them (3ms imperfect ይሁብ + -ሙ '3mp them')
to the weak (ለ- + adjective used as noun, plural ድኩማን)
according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ግብርከ ፨
sentences.tr: wäybelo ḥor ḫäbä gəbrəkä
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: Go to your-work.
sentences.i: Then he said to him, "Go to your work."
sentences.n: ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'; ሖር 'go!' (imperative of ሖረ); ኀበ 'to'; ግብርከ 'your work' (ግብር + -ከ). The unit ends with the mark ፨, which in Bezold closes a section (cf. the ten marks at the end of the chapter).

morph.gloss: and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይቤላ ፡ ለንግሥት ፡ ምንት ፡ በቊዔትነ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢገበርነ ፡ ንስሐ ፡ ወምሕረተ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፤
sentences.tr: wäkaʿbä yəbela längəśt mənt bäqʷiʿetnä läʾgʷalä ʾəmäḥyaw läʾmä ʾigäbärnä nəsḥä wämḥərätä bädibä mədr
sentences.l: And-again he-said-to-her to-the-queen: What [is] our-benefit, to-the-offspring-of man [lit. mother-of-the-living], if we-do-not-do repentance and-mercy upon earth?
sentences.i: And again he said to the queen, "What good is it to us, the children of men, if we do not practice repentance and mercy on earth?
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'; ይቤላ 'he said to her' (ይቤ + ላ). ንግሥት is in apposition to ላ: the pronoun and the noun together, 'to her, to the queen'. ምንት 'what?'; በቊዔትነ 'our benefit' (ቊዔት 'profit, benefit' + -ነ 'our'; በ- here 'in/for', the unit reads 'what is in our benefit'). ለእጓለ እመሕያው 'to the offspring of man' (እጓለ is the construct of እጓል 'offspring, child'; እመሕያው, literally 'mother of the living' (a compound of እም 'mother' and ሕያው 'living'), stands in the genitive after the construct and means 'mankind, a human being'; so እጓለ እመሕያው is 'child of man', the 'son of man' of the Psalms and the Gospels). ለእመ 'if' (ለ- + እመ); ኢገበርነ 'we did not do' (negative ኢ- + perfect ገበርነ, 'we did'), ንስሐ 'repentance', ምሕረተ 'mercy' (accusative), በዲበ ምድር 'upon the earth'. These two virtues, repentance and mercy, set the sermon's theme.

morph.gloss: he said to her (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ላ '3fs to her')
in our benefit (በ- + noun 'profit, benefit' + -ነ '1cp our')
to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
we did not do (negative ኢ- + 1cp perfect, g-b-r)

sentences.t: አኮኑ ፡ ኵልነ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ዘበጊዜሃ ፡ ይየብስ ፡ ወያውዕዮ ፡ እሳት ፤
sentences.tr: ʾäkonu kʷəlnä käntu śaʿrä gädam zäbägizeha yəyäbs wäyawʿəyo ʾəsat
sentences.l: Are-we-not all vanity, grass-of wilderness which in-its-time withers, and-fire burns-it?
sentences.i: Are we not all vanity, like the grass of the wilderness that withers in its season and that fire burns?
sentences.n: አኮኑ 'is it not so?'; ኵልነ 'all of us' (ኵሉ + -ነ); ከንቱ 'vain, empty' (cf. Ecclesiastes 1:2). ሣዕረ ገዳም is a construct, 'grass of the wilderness' (ሣዕር 'grass', ገዳም 'wilderness'), standing in apposition. ዘበጊዜሃ ይየብስ 'which in its time withers' (ዘ- 'which' + በ- 'in' + ጊዜ 'time' + -ሃ 'its'; ይየብስ, የብሰ 'be dry'). ወያውዕዮ 'and it burns it' (አውዐየ 'burn', causative; the subject እሳት 'fire' follows). The image echoes Isaiah 40:6-8 and Psalm 103 (102):15-16, where human life is grass; cf. Psalm 37 (36):2.

morph.gloss: is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
which in its time (ዘ- relative + በ- 'in' + noun + -ሃ '3fs its')
and it burns it (ወ- + 3ms imperfect of the causative + -ዮ '3ms it')

sentences.t: በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ንትረሰይ ፡ በመባልዕት ፡ ጥዑማት ፡ ወበአልባስ ፡ ክቡራት ፤
sentences.tr: bädibä mədr nəträsäy bämäbalʿət ṭəʿumat wäbäʾälbas kəburat
sentences.l: Upon earth we-are-made(?) with-foods sweet and-with-clothing precious;
sentences.i: On earth we make ourselves comfortable (?) with sweet food and costly clothing,
sentences.n: ንትረሰይ 'we are made / we make ourselves': ተረሰየ is the passive-reflexive of ረሰየ 'make, set'. The English 'make ourselves comfortable' is an interpretation. በመባልዕት ጥዑማት 'with foods, sweet ones' (መብልዕ 'food', plural መባልዕት; ጥዑም 'sweet'; the adjective agrees as plural feminine), ወበአልባስ ክቡራት 'and with clothing, precious ones'. The two parallel constructions (እንዘ 'while' + noun + adjective) in the following lines contrast outward ease with inward ruin.

morph.gloss: we are made, we make ourselves (1cp imperfect; passive-reflexive of ረሰየ)
and with clothing (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural/collective አልባስ)

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ጽዩኣን ፤
sentences.tr: ʾənzä ḥəyawan ṣəyuʾan
sentences.l: while living, loathsome(?);
sentences.i: though we are alive, we are loathsome (?);
sentences.n: እንዘ ሕያዋን ጽዩኣን 'while living ones, [ṣəyuʾan]'. ሕያዋን is the plural of ሕያው 'living'. ጽዩኣን is the plural of ጽዩእ; I am not sure of it. It may come from ጸየአ 'be foul, loathsome', which would suit the contrast with ሕያዋን. The series that follows ('alive, but dead; wise, but fools; honored, but lacking') makes a negative sense very likely.

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
living (plural ሕያዋን, adj.) · used as plural noun/predicate: እንዘ ሕያዋን 'while living (ones)'
loathsome (?) (adjective, plural ጽዩኣን; the singular is reconstructed from this plural, the sense is uncertain, perhaps from ጸየአ)

sentences.t: ወንትረሰይ ፡ በመዐዛት ፡ ወበዕፍረታት ፤
sentences.tr: wäntəräsäy bämäʿäzat wäbäʿfərätat
sentences.l: and-we-make-ourselves with-fragrances and-with-ointments;
sentences.i: we make ourselves fragrant with perfumes and ointments,
sentences.n: ወንትረሰይ is the same verb as above, 'we make ourselves' (so I render it 'make ourselves fragrant'). መዐዛት 'fragrances' (plural of መዐዛ 'sweet smell'), ዕፍረታት 'ointments, perfumes' (plural of ዕፍረት). በ- 'with'.

morph.gloss: and we make ourselves (ወ- + 1cp imperfect; passive-reflexive of ረሰየ)
and with ointments, perfumes (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዕፍረታት; cf. ዕፍረተ in ch. 17–20)

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ምዉታን ፡ በኀጢዓት ፡ ወበዓበሳት ፤
sentences.tr: ʾənzä ḥəyawan məwutan bäḫäṭiʿat wäbäʿabäsat
sentences.l: while living, dead in-sins and-in-offences(?);
sentences.i: though we are alive, we are dead in sins and in offences (?);
sentences.n: ምዉታን 'dead ones' (plural of ምዉት). ኀጢዓት 'sin' (plural, or the collective form, 'sins'); ዓበሳት 'offences, transgressions' (?), plural of ዓበሳ, a noun I do not know well. 'Dead in sins' recalls Ephesians 2:1.

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
living (plural ሕያዋን, adj.) · used as plural noun/predicate: እንዘ ሕያዋን 'while living (ones)'
in sins (በ- + noun, plural or collective)
and in offences (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዓበሳት; the noun is not well known)

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ጠቢባን ፡ ኮነ ፡ አብዳነ ፡ በኢሰሚዕ ፡ ወበዕልወታት ፤
sentences.tr: ʾənzä ṭäbiban konä ʾäbdanä bäʾisämiʿ wäbäʿləwätat
sentences.l: while wise, became [3ms; sic] fools through-not-hearing and-through-perversities(?);
sentences.i: though we are wise, we have become fools through not listening and through perversities (?);
sentences.n: ጠቢባን 'wise ones' (plural of ጠቢብ), ኮነ 'we became' (the form ኮነ is 3ms 'he/it became'; a 1cp 'we became' would be ኮንነ. Bezold's form is odd: either the doubling is lost in spelling or the sense is impersonal; I render 'we have become' from the context of 'we' in the surrounding lines). አብዳነ 'fools' (accusative plural of አብድ, 'foolish'). በኢሰሚዕ 'through not-hearing' (negative ኢ- + the noun ሰሚዕ; the infinitive-like 'disobedience'). ዕልወታት 'perversities' (?): possibly from ዐልወ 'be crooked, perverse'; uncertain. The echo is Romans 1:22, 'claiming to be wise they became fools'.

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
wise men (noun, plural ጠቢባን) · adjective 'wise' used predicatively: እንዘ ጠቢባን 'while wise (ones)'
he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic)
fools (adjective used as noun, accusative plural)
through not hearing (በ- + negative ኢ- + verbal noun ሰሚዕ of ሰምዐ)
and through transgressions, perversities (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዕልወታት; cf. ዕልወት in ch. 2–8)

sentences.t: እንዘ ፡ ክቡራን ፡ ኮነ ፡ ኅሱራነ ፡ በተጠይሮ ፡ ወበሰጊድ ፡ ለጣዖት ።
sentences.tr: ʾənzä kəburan konä ḫəsuranä bätäṭäyro wäbäsägid läṭaʿot
sentences.l: while honored, became [3ms; sic] lacking through-[täṭäyro] and-through-bowing to-idols.
sentences.i: though we are honored, we have become lacking through [täṭäyro] (?) and through bowing down to idols.
sentences.n: ክቡራን 'honored ones' (plural of ክቡር); ኅሱራነ 'deficient, lacking' (accusative plural of ኅሱር 'wanting'); the same as in the previous unit, ኮነ is used for 'we became'. ተጠይሮ I cannot identify. Since it is joined with idol-worship it may name a pagan practice, perhaps augury, but that is a guess; I leave it as [täṭäyro]. ሰጊድ 'bowing, worship' (the verbal noun of ሰገደ), ጣዖት 'idols' (Greek loan; ለ- 'to'). The rhetoric (ምዉታን, አብዳነ, ኅሱራነ) is that of the preacher against the Queen's idol-worshiping people: Solomon is shaping his argument toward her question.

morph.gloss: while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic)
and through bowing, worship (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun of ሰገደ)

sentences.t: ሰብእሰ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ዘተፈጥረ ፡ በአምሳለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወለእመኒ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.tr: säbʾəsä kəbur zätäfäṭrä bäʾämsalä ʾəgziʾabḥer wäläʾmäni gäbrä śänayä yəkäwn kämä ʾəgziʾabḥer
sentences.l: Man indeed [is] honorable who-was-created in-the-likeness-of God, and-if he-does good he-becomes like God;
sentences.i: Man is honorable, for he was created in the likeness of God, and if he does good he becomes like God.
sentences.n: ሰብእሰ 'man indeed, but man' (ሰብእ + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ; it sets 'man as made' against 'man as acting'). ክቡር 'honored'. ዘተፈጥረ 'who was created' (ተፈጥረ, the passive of ፈጠረ 'create'). በአምሳለ እግዚኣብሔር 'in the likeness of God': አምሳለ is the construct of አምሳል, 'likeness, image', followed by the name; so 'in God's image'. The allusion is to Genesis 1:26-27, and the previous part ended on the same thought. ወለእመኒ ገብረ ሠናየ 'and if he did good' (ለእመ 'if' + -ኒ, ገብረ 'did', ሠናየ 'good', accusative); ይከውን 'he becomes' (ኮነ, imperfect), ከመ 'like'.

sentences.l: The-Devil indeed [is] proud, who grew-great(?) obeying to-his-Creator; and-all the-proud from-men walk in-his-way, and-are-condemned with-him;
sentences.i: The Devil is proud, for he refused to obey his Creator. And all the proud among men walk in his way and are condemned along with him.
sentences.n: ዲያብሎስሰ 'the Devil indeed' (-ሰ contrastive again). ዕቡይ 'proud'. ዘዓበየ ተአዝዞ ለፈጣሪሁ: ዓበየ 'was great, was arrogant' (ዓበየ also 'become great'); ተአዝዞ is the 3ms gerund of ተአዘዘ 'obey' ('obeying, having obeyed'; the verb takes ለ-); ለፈጣሪሁ 'to his Creator' (ፈጣሪ, the agent noun of ፈጠረ 'create', + -ሁ). I take ዓበየ in its bad sense, 'was insolent', which yields 'refused to obey'; that is an interpretation. ኵሎሙ ዕቡያን 'all the proud'. እምሰብእ 'from among men'. የሐውሩ 'they walk', በፍኖቱ 'in his way' (ፍኖት 'road, way'; 'to walk in the way' is a biblical image for conduct, as in Psalm 1). ይትኴነኑ 'they are condemned, judged' (ተኴነነ, passive of ኴነነ 'judge'); ምስሌሁ 'with him'.

sentences.i: But God loves the humble, and those who practice humility walk in his way and rejoice in his kingdom.
sentences.n: ወእግዚኣብሔር 'and God' (here 'but'). ያፈቅሮሙ ለትሑታን 'he loves them, the humble' (አፍቀረ 'love'; the pronoun ሙ 'them' is repeated by the noun with ለ-; a regular Geʿez pattern of anticipating the object). ወእለ ይገብሩ ትሕትና 'and those who do humility' (እለ 'those who', ትሕትና 'humility', from ትሑት 'humble'). ይትፌሥሑ 'they rejoice' (ተፈሥሐ); መንግሥቱ 'his kingdom'. sentences.l: And-blessed [is] he-who-knew wisdom, that-is repentance and-the-fear-of God.
sentences.i: Blessed is he who has known wisdom, which is repentance and the fear of God."
sentences.n: ወብፁዕሰ 'and blessed indeed' (ብፁዕ 'blessed', the -ሰ contrastive). ዘአእመረ 'who knew' (አእመረ 'know'); ጥበበ 'wisdom' (accusative); ዝውእቱ 'that is' (literally 'this is' ዝ + ውእቱ). ፈሪሀ is the construct of ፈሪህ 'fear' (related to ፍርሀት and ፈሪሆት; ፈሪሀ እግዚአብሔር is the familiar phrase 'fear of God'), here followed by እግዚኣብሔር 'of God'. The thought is that of Proverbs 1:7 and 9:10, 'the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom', and Psalm 111 (110):10. Solomon's speech ends here, with ፨.

sentences.i: We bow to the sun because he ripens (?) food, and because he makes the darkness light and takes away fear.
sentences.n: ያበስል 'he cooks, ripens' (አብሰለ, the causative of በሰለ 'be ripe, cooked'); ሲሳየ 'food, sustenance' (accusative); ወካዕበ 'and again, and moreover'; ያበርህ 'he makes bright' (አብርሀ, the causative of በርሀ 'be bright'); ጽልመተ 'darkness' (accusative); ያአትት 'he removes, takes away' (አአተተ; the stem I know less well); ፍርሀተ 'fear' (accusative). The three benefits are the queen's reasons for sun-worship: food, light, and security from night.

sentences.l: But we-heard that you-have, to-Israel, another god whom not we-know, we; and-they-told-us that he-brought-down for-you the-Ark from-the-heavens, and-he-gave-you tablets, the-ordinance-of angels, by-the-hand-of Moses his-prophet; we-heard this;
sentences.i: But we have heard that you, Israel, have another god whom we do not know. They told us that he brought down the Ark for you from the heavens, and gave you the tablets, the ordinance of the angels, by the hand of Moses, his prophet. This we have heard;
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ 'but'. ሰማዕነ 'we heard' (ሰምዐ). ብክሙአ 'you (pl.) have' (ብ- 'there is to' + ክሙ 'you'), with an extra -አ that I cannot explain (an interrogative particle, perhaps, but she is reporting what she has heard, so I do not render it). ለእስራኤል 'to Israel': the vocative or apposition. ካልአ አምላከ 'another god' (accusative). ዘኢናአምሮ ንሕነ 'whom we do not know' (ዘ- + ኢ- + ናአምሮ, from አእመረ 'know', + the pronoun ሮ 'him'; ንሕነ 'we' repeats the subject for stress). ወዜነዉነ 'and they told us' (ዜነወ 'tell, report'). ከመ አውረደ 'that he brought down' (አውረደ, the causative of ወረደ 'descend'). ለክሙ 'for you'. ታቦተ 'the Ark' (accusative of ታቦት): the Ark is central to the book. The queen already speaks of it as something that came down from heaven, which is the book's own view, not Exodus 25. ወወሀበክሙ 'and he gave you'. ጽላተ 'tablets' (accusative), ሥርዐተ መላእክት 'the ordinance of the angels': ሥርዐተ is a construct, 'ordinance of'. The reference to angels is that of the later tradition that the Law came 'through angels' (Acts 7:53; Galatians 3:19; Hebrews 2:2). በእደ ሙሴ ነቢዩ 'by the hand of Moses his prophet' (ነቢይ 'prophet' + -ሁ 'his', God's prophet). ሰማዕነ ዘንተ 'we heard this' repeats the opening verb to close the report.

sentences.l: And-does-he-come-down [ʾa] to-you himself, and-speak-with-you, and-teach-you his-judgment and-his-commandment?
sentences.i: Does he himself come down to you, and speak with you, and teach you his judgment and his commandments?"
sentences.n: ወይወርድ አ ኀቤክሙ ለሊሁ: ይወርድ 'he comes down' (ወረደ). I take the detached አ as the question particle (written apart from the verb here), so 'does he come down...?' If that is wrong the sentence is a plain statement, 'and he comes down to you himself'. ኀቤክሙ 'to you' (ኀበ + -ክሙ); ለሊሁ 'himself'. ይትናገረክሙ 'he speaks with you' (ተናገረ + -ክሙ); ይኤምረክሙ 'he teaches you, makes you know' (?) (3ms imperfect of አእመረ, which is itself the causative 'make know', + -ክሙ 'you'; the spelling ይኤምር for the usual ያአምር is odd and the reading is uncertain to me). ፍትሖ 'his judgment' (ፍትሕ + -ሁ, vowel written -ሖ), ትእዛዞ 'his commandment' (ትእዛዝ + -ሁ). The chapter ends with a run of ten ፨ marks, which are a section close; they stay on the last unit. Her speech turns, as it will for several chapters, to Israel's God.

glossary.ንግረኒኬ: ነገረ — tell me then (2ms imperative ንግር + -ኒ 'me' + enclitic -ኬ 'then, now')
glossary.አ: አ — [ʾa], question particle (?) (written detached from the verb)
glossary.አልባሲሁ: ልብስ — his clothes (noun, plural አልባስ, stem አልባሲ- + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
glossary.አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
glossary.አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.አብዳነ: አብድ — fools (adjective used as noun, accusative plural)
glossary.አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አውረደ: አውረደ — he brought down (3ms perfect, causative of ወረደ)
glossary.አገበረኒ: አገበረ — he made me work (3ms perfect, causative of ገብረ, + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.አፉከ: አፍ — your mouth (noun, stem አፉ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ኢገበርነ: ገብረ — we did not do (negative ኢ- + 1cp perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ኣስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — I appear, am made to appear (1s imperfect, causative-reflexive of ርእየ)
glossary.እመሕያው: እመሕያው — mankind, human being (noun; compound of እም 'mother' + ሕያው 'living'; genitive after እጓለ)
glossary.እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.እምታሕቴነ: ታሕተ — from beneath us, below us (እም- + preposition, stem ታሕቴ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
glossary.እምአግአዞ: አግአዘ — from he set him free (?) (እም- + 3ms perfect 'set free' + -ኦ 'him'; the function of እም- before a finite verb and the sense of the clause are uncertain)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.እከውን: ኮነ — I will become, be (imperf. 1s, k-w-n)
glossary.ክልኤነ: ክልኤ — we two, both of us (numeral 'two' + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ክቡራት: ክቡር — precious, costly (adjective, fem. plural ክቡራት)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ወሃፉ: ሃፍ — and his sweat (?) (ወ- + noun + -ሁ 'his'; the noun is not firmly known)
glossary.ወለእመኒ: ለእመ — and even if (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ 'if' + enclitic -ኒ 'even')
glossary.ወለዕፀውኒ: ዕፅ — and also the wood, sticks (ወ- + ለ- object marker + plural ዕፀው + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሊተኒ: ሊተ — and to me also (ወ- + ሊተ '1s to me' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወመክሥተ: መክሥት — and the opening of (ወ- + noun, construct/accusative)
glossary.ወማየ: ማይ — and the water of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወሥጡጣት: ሥጡጥ — and torn (?) (ወ- + adjective/participle, fem. plural ሥጡጣት; the singular is reconstructed from this one plural and the root ሠጠጠ 'tear' is unconfirmed; the sense rests on the pairing with ብሉያት 'worn')
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወሳእረ: ሳእር — and a water-skin (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative or construct; sense inferred from the context)
glossary.ወቆመ: ቆመ — and he stood (ወ- + 3ms perfect, q-w-m)
glossary.ወበሰጊድ: ሰጊድ — and through bowing, worship (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun of ሰገደ)
glossary.ወበአልባስ: ልብስ — and with clothing (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural/collective አልባስ)
glossary.ወበዓበሳት: ዓበሳ — and in offences (?) (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዓበሳት; the noun is not well known)
glossary.ወበዕልወታት: ዕልወት — and through transgressions, perversities (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዕልወታት; cf. ዕልወት in ch. 2–8)
glossary.ወበዕፍረታት: ዕፍረት — and with ointments, perfumes (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ዕፍረታት; cf. ዕፍረተ in ch. 17–20)
glossary.ወባዕዳንሂ: ባዕድ — and others too (ወ- + noun/adjective, plural ባዕዳን + enclitic -ሂ 'too')
glossary.ወብሉያት: ብሉይ — and worn (ወ- + adjective, fem. plural ብሉያት)
glossary.ወብፁዕሰ: ብፁዕ — and blessed indeed (ወ- + adjective + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወቦእለ: ቦ — and there are those who (ወ- + ቦ 'there is' + relative እለ, run together)
glossary.ወተመይጠ: ተመይጠ — and he turned (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of መይጠ)
glossary.ወትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — and his commandment (ወ- + noun, accusative ትእዛዘ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — and he passed, went by (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንሰግድ: ሰገደ — and we bow (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወንብሎ: ብህለ — and we say to him, we call him (ወ- + 1cp imperfect + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወንትረሰይ: ተረሰየ — and we make ourselves (ወ- + 1cp imperfect; passive-reflexive of ረሰየ)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሀበክሙ: ወሀበ — and he gave you (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወዓሣእኒሁ: ሣእን — and his sandals (?) (ወ- + plural አሣእን, stem አሣእኒ- + -ሁ 'his'; sense uncertain)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዜነዉነ: ዜነወ — and they told us (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — and this one (ወ- + m. demonstrative)
glossary.ወያአትት: አአተተ — and he removes, takes away (ወ- + 3ms imperfect; the stem is not well known)
glossary.ወያውዕዮ: አውዐየ — and it burns it (ወ- + 3ms imperfect of the causative + -ዮ '3ms it')
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይትናገረክሙ: ተናገረ — and he speaks with you (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ነገረ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወይትኴነኑ: ተኰነነ — and they are judged, condemned (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, passive of ኰነነ 'judge, condemn'; written with ኴ)
glossary.ወይኤምረክሙ: አእመረ — and he teaches you, makes you know (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, spelled ይኤምር for the usual ያአምር, + -ክሙ '2mp you'; the reading is uncertain)
glossary.ወጺአት: ጺአት — and [ṣiʾät], meaning unclear (?) (ወ- + unknown noun)
glossary.ወፈሪሀ: ፈሪህ — and the fear of (ወ- + noun, construct ፈሪሀ; from ፈርሀ 'fear', the same word as ፍርሀት, ፈሪሆት; ፈሪሀ እግዚአብሔር 'fear of God') (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዓምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct; variant spelling ዓምላከ) · also accusative 'a god' (ባዕደ ዓምላከ 'another god')
glossary.ዕፄ: ዕፄ — [ʿəṣe], meaning unclear (?); elsewhere 'emperor', which does not fit here
glossary.ዘበጊዜሃ: ጊዜ — which in its time (ዘ- relative + በ- 'in' + noun + -ሃ '3fs its')
glossary.ዘተፈጥረ: ተፈጥረ — which was created (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ዘነገረነ: ነገረ — who told us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘኢናአምሮ: አእመረ — whom we do not know (ዘ- relative + negative ኢ- + 1cp imperfect ናአምር + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ዘኢይመውት: ሞተ — who does not die (ዘ- + negative ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይመውት, m-w-t)
glossary.ዘእንበሌሁ: ዘእንበለ — besides him, without him (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.ዘዓበየ: ዐበየ — who was great, arrogant (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, written ዓበየ; the bad sense 'was insolent' is an interpretation)
glossary.ዘጌሠመ: ጌሠም — who tomorrow (?) (ዘ- + noun 'tomorrow'; the ending is unusual)
glossary.ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያበርህ: አብርሀ — he makes bright (3ms imperfect, causative of በርሀ)
glossary.ያበስል: አብሰለ — he cooks, ripens (?) (3ms imperfect, causative of በሰለ)
glossary.ያፈቅሮሙ: አፍቀረ — he loves them (3ms imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይሁቦሙ: ወሀበ — he gives them (3ms imperfect ይሁብ + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይረትዕ: ረትዐ — he is true, right (3ms imperfect, r-t-ʿ)
glossary.ይቤላ: ብህለ — he said to her (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይትናገራ: ተናገረ — he was speaking with her (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ነገረ 'speak', + -ኣ '3fs, with her')
glossary.ይየብስ: የብሰ — it withers, is dry (3ms imperfect)
glossary.ይጸንዕ: ጸንዐ — he is strong (3ms imperfect, ṣ-n-ʿ)
glossary.ደመሮን: ደመረ — he gathered them (3ms perfect + -ሆን '3fp, them')
glossary.ዲያብሎስሰ: ዲያብሎስ — the Devil indeed (noun, Greek loan + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ገባራዊ: ገባራዊ — of the laborer, 'the laborer-ly (one)' (adjective in -ዊ from ገባር 'laborer'; used as a noun in the heading)
glossary.ገባር: ገባር — workman, labourer (noun; agent noun of ገብረ)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
glossary.ጠቢባን: ጠቢብ — wise men (noun, plural ጠቢባን) · adjective 'wise' used predicatively: እንዘ ጠቢባን 'while wise (ones)'
glossary.ጽላተ: ጽላት — tablets of (noun, plural; construct before ዘኪዳን)
glossary.ጽዩኣን: ጽዩእ — loathsome (?) (adjective, plural ጽዩኣን; the singular is reconstructed from this plural, the sense is uncertain, perhaps from ጸየአ)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈጣሪነ: ፈጣሪ — our creator (agent noun of ፈጠረ + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — fear (construct 'fear of') · also accusative, object: ያአትት ፍርሀተ 'he removes fear'
glossary.ፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — his judgment (noun, accusative ፍትሐ + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ፍድፍድናየ: ፍድፍድና — my superiority, advantage (?) (noun + -የ '1s my'; the lemma is reconstructed from this form, cf. ፍድፋድ 'abundance, excess'; a guess from the sequence)
glossary.፳፯: ፳፯ — 27, spoken ዕሥራ ወሰብዐቱ (ʿəśra wä-säbʿätu) 'twenty-seven'; chapter number (numeral)
